items.myth: Abroad sirf toppers ke liye hai
items.fact: Har profile ke liye options hain
items.detail: Universities alag alag level ki hoti hain. Sahi shortlist sabse zaroori hai.

items.myth: Bahut mehenga hai, apne bas ka nahi
items.detail: Kai students funding plan karke jaate hain. Pehle budget banao, phir country chuno.
Har course ka minimum score hota hai. Prep karo, mock do, aage badho.
